verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for a remote-desktop and team-access platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents user-definable rules, triggers, or webhooks that fire actions on events such as connections or logins. The Teams API is described only as a way to automate deployment and pull audit logs, which is a developer building block rather than a rules-and-triggers capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
